$comment: Catálogo como datos. P(i) es el parámetro i; src(uv) lee la entrada; uTime y uBeat, el reloj; uSize, la resolución. El manual no publica el catálogo ni las fórmulas: nombres y cálculos son propios.

effects.name: Transform
effects.glsl: vec2 q = (uv - 0.5 - vec2(P(0), -P(1))) * uSize; float a = radians(P(3)); q = mat2(cos(a), sin(a), -sin(a), cos(a)) * q; q = q / P(2) / uSize + 0.5; return (q.x < 0.0 || q.x > 1.0 || q.y < 0.0 || q.y > 1.0) ? vec4(0.0) : src(q);

effects.name: Brillo y contraste
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); vec3 k = unpre(c); k = (k - 0.5) * P(1) + 0.5 + P(0); return pre(k, c.a);

effects.name: Tono
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); vec3 k = unpre(c); float a = P(0) * 6.28318; vec3 u = vec3(0.57735); k = k * cos(a) + cross(u, k) * sin(a) + u * dot(u, k) * (1.0 - cos(a)); return pre(k, c.a);

effects.name: Saturación
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); vec3 k = unpre(c); return pre(mix(vec3(dot(k, LUMA)), k, P(0)), c.a);

effects.name: Invertir
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); vec3 k = unpre(c); vec3 m = vec3(P(0), P(1), P(2)); return pre(mix(k, 1.0 - k, m), c.a);

effects.name: Umbral
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); return pre(vec3(step(P(0), dot(unpre(c), LUMA))), c.a);

effects.name: Posterizar
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); float n = floor(P(0)); return pre(floor(unpre(c) * n) / (n - 1.0), c.a);

effects.name: Colorear
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); return pre(vec3(dot(unpre(c), LUMA)) * vec3(P(0), P(1), P(2)), c.a);

effects.name: Gamma
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); return pre(pow(unpre(c), vec3(1.0 / P(0))), c.a);

effects.name: Exposición
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); return pre(unpre(c) * pow(2.0, P(0)), c.a);

effects.name: LUT
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); float n = float(textureSize(uTex1, 0).y); if (n < 2.0) return c; vec3 k = clamp(unpre(c), 0.0, 1.0) * (n - 1.0); float z = floor(min(k.b, n - 2.0)); float f = k.b - z; vec2 t = (k.rg + 0.5) / vec2(n * n, n); vec4 a = texture(uTex1, t + vec2(z / n, 0.0)); vec4 b = texture(uTex1, t + vec2((z + 1.0) / n, 0.0)); return pre(mix(a, b, f).rgb, c.a);

effects.name: Auto Mask
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); float a = clamp(dot(unpre(c), LUMA) / P(0), 0.0, 1.0); return c * a;

effects.name: Pixelar
effects.glsl: vec2 g = uSize / floor(P(0)); return src((floor(uv * g) + 0.5) / g);

effects.name: Flip
effects.glsl: vec2 q = uv; if (P(0) > 0.5) q.x = 1.0 - q.x; if (P(1) > 0.5) q.y = 1.0 - q.y; return src(q);

effects.name: Espejo
effects.glsl: vec2 q = uv; if (P(0) > 0.5) q.x = 0.5 - abs(q.x - 0.5); if (P(1) > 0.5) q.y = 0.5 - abs(q.y - 0.5); return src(q);

effects.name: Caleidoscopio
effects.glsl: vec2 q = uv - 0.5; float s = 6.28318 / floor(P(0)); float a = abs(mod(atan(q.y, q.x) + P(1) * 6.28318, s) - s * 0.5); return src(0.5 + length(q) * vec2(cos(a), sin(a)));

effects.name: Wave Warp
effects.glsl: return src(uv + vec2(sin(uv.y * P(1) + uTime * P(2)), cos(uv.x * P(1) + uTime * P(2))) * P(0));

effects.name: Ondas
effects.glsl: vec2 q = uv - 0.5; float r = length(q); return src(uv + normalize(q + 1e-5) * sin(r * P(1) - uTime * P(2)) * P(0));

effects.name: Remolino
effects.glsl: vec2 q = uv - 0.5; float t = max(0.0, 1.0 - length(q) / P(1)); float a = t * t * P(0); return src(0.5 + mat2(cos(a), sin(a), -sin(a), cos(a)) * q);

effects.name: Mosaico
effects.glsl: return src(fract(uv * vec2(floor(P(0)), floor(P(1)))));

effects.name: Ojo de pez
effects.glsl: vec2 q = uv - 0.5; return src(0.5 + q * (1.0 + P(0) * dot(q, q) * 2.0));

effects.name: Pulso al beat
effects.glsl: float t = 1.0 - fract(uBeat / P(1)); return src(0.5 + (uv - 0.5) / (1.0 + P(0) * t * t * t));

effects.name: Estrobo al beat
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); return c * mix(1.0, step(0.5, fract(uBeat / P(1))) , P(0));

effects.name: Shift RGB
effects.glsl: vec2 d = vec2(P(0), 0.0); vec4 c = src(uv); return vec4(src(uv + d).r, c.g, src(uv - d).b, c.a);

effects.name: Desenfoque
effects.glsl: vec4 s = vec4(0.0); float w = 0.0; for (int x = -4; x <= 4; ++x) for (int y = -4; y <= 4; ++y) { float g = exp(-float(x * x + y * y) / 8.0); s += src(uv + vec2(x, y) * P(0) / 4.0 / uSize) * g; w += g; } return s / w;

effects.name: Enfocar
effects.glsl: vec2 p = 1.0 / uSize; vec4 c = src(uv); vec4 b = (src(uv + vec2(p.x, 0.0)) + src(uv - vec2(p.x, 0.0)) + src(uv + vec2(0.0, p.y)) + src(uv - vec2(0.0, p.y))) * 0.25; return clamp(c + (c - b) * P(0), 0.0, 1.0);

effects.name: Bordes
effects.glsl: vec2 p = 1.0 / uSize; float gx = dot(src(uv + vec2(p.x, 0.0)).rgb - src(uv - vec2(p.x, 0.0)).rgb, LUMA); float gy = dot(src(uv + vec2(0.0, p.y)).rgb - src(uv - vec2(0.0, p.y)).rgb, LUMA); vec4 c = src(uv); return vec4(vec3(clamp(length(vec2(gx, gy)) * P(0), 0.0, 1.0)) * c.a, c.a);

effects.name: Relieve
effects.glsl: vec2 p = 2.0 / uSize; vec4 c = src(uv); float d = dot(src(uv + p).rgb - src(uv - p).rgb, LUMA); return vec4(vec3(clamp(0.5 + d * P(0), 0.0, 1.0)) * c.a, c.a);

effects.name: Viñeta
effects.glsl: float d = length((uv - 0.5) * vec2(uSize.x / uSize.y, 1.0)); return src(uv) * (1.0 - clamp(smoothstep(P(1), P(1) + 0.5, d) * P(0), 0.0, 1.0));

effects.name: Ruido
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); return clamp(c + (hash(uv + fract(uTime)) - 0.5) * P(0) * c.a, 0.0, 1.0);

effects.name: Trama de puntos
effects.glsl: vec2 g = uSize / P(0); vec2 cell = (floor(uv * g) + 0.5) / g; vec4 c = src(cell); float r = length(fract(uv * g) - 0.5) * 2.0; return c * step(r, sqrt(dot(unpre(c), LUMA)));

effects.name: Clave de color
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); vec3 k = clamp(abs(mod(P(1) * 6.0 + vec3(0.0, 4.0, 2.0), 6.0) - 3.0) - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0); float m = smoothstep(P(2) * 0.5, P(2) * 1.5 + 0.01, distance(normalize(c.rgb + 0.001), normalize(k))); return vec4(c.rgb, c.a * mix(1.0, m, P(0)));

effects.name: Clave de luminancia
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); float l = dot(c.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114)); return vec4(c.rgb, c.a * mix(1.0, smoothstep(P(1), P(1) + P(2) + 0.001, l), P(0)));

effects.name: Ciclo de color
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); float a = 6.2832 * fract(uBeat * P(1) * 0.25 + P(2)); vec3 k = vec3(0.57735); vec3 r = c.rgb * cos(a) + cross(k, c.rgb) * sin(a) + k * dot(k, c.rgb) * (1.0 - cos(a)); return vec4(mix(c.rgb, r, P(0)), c.a);

effects.name: Niveles
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); vec3 v = clamp((c.rgb - P(0)) / max(P(1) - P(0), 0.001), 0.0, 1.0); return vec4(pow(v, vec3(1.0 / P(2))), c.a);

effects.name: Sepia
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); vec3 s = vec3(dot(c.rgb, vec3(0.393, 0.769, 0.189)), dot(c.rgb, vec3(0.349, 0.686, 0.168)), dot(c.rgb, vec3(0.272, 0.534, 0.131))); return vec4(mix(c.rgb, s, P(0)), c.a);

effects.name: Resplandor
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); vec3 g = vec3(0.0); for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) { float a = float(i) * 0.5236; vec2 o = vec2(cos(a), sin(a)) * P(1); vec3 t = src(uv + o).rgb + src(uv + o * 0.5).rgb; g += max(t - P(2) * 2.0, 0.0); } return vec4(c.rgb + g / 12.0 * P(0) * 2.0, c.a);

effects.name: Acuarela
effects.glsl: vec2 q = uv * P(1); vec2 n = vec2(sin(q.y * 1.7 + sin(q.x * 0.9)), cos(q.x * 1.3 + sin(q.y * 1.1))) * 0.004; vec4 c = src(uv + n * P(0)); vec4 d = src(uv - n * P(0)); vec3 v = floor(mix(c.rgb, d.rgb, 0.5) * P(2) + 0.5) / P(2); return vec4(mix(src(uv).rgb, v, P(0)), c.a);

effects.name: Semitono
effects.glsl: float s = sin(P(2)), k = cos(P(2)); vec2 p = mat2(k, -s, s, k) * (uv * uSize) / P(1); vec4 c = src(uv); float l = dot(c.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114)); float r = length(fract(p) - 0.5); float m = smoothstep(0.0, 0.08, sqrt(l) * 0.7 - r); return vec4(mix(c.rgb, c.rgb * m, P(0)), c.a);

effects.name: Trama
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); float l = dot(c.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114)); vec2 p = uv * uSize; float t = 1.0; if (l < 0.75 && mod(p.x + p.y, P(1)) < 1.5) t = 0.0; if (l < 0.5 && mod(p.x - p.y, P(1)) < 1.5) t = 0.0; if (l < 0.25 && mod(p.x + p.y - P(1) * 0.5, P(1)) < 1.5) t = 0.0; return vec4(mix(c.rgb, c.rgb * t, P(0)), c.a);

effects.name: Fallo digital
effects.glsl: float b = floor(uv.y * P(1)); float t = floor(uBeat * P(2) * 4.0); float h = fract(sin(b * 12.9898 + t * 78.233) * 43758.5453); float o = (h > 0.7 ? (h - 0.85) * 0.5 : 0.0) * P(0); vec4 c = src(uv + vec2(o, 0.0)); c.r = src(uv + vec2(o * 1.5, 0.0)).r; c.b = src(uv - vec2(o * 0.5, 0.0)).b; return c;

effects.name: Grano
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); float n = fract(sin(dot(uv * uSize + uTime * 60.0, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453) - 0.5; return vec4(c.rgb + n * P(0) * 0.5, c.a);

effects.name: Desenfoque radial
effects.glsl: vec2 m = vec2(P(1), P(2)); vec4 s = vec4(0.0); for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) s += src(mix(uv, m, float(i) / 16.0 * P(0) * 0.5)); return s / 16.0;

effects.name: Desenfoque direccional
effects.glsl: vec2 d = vec2(cos(P(1)), sin(P(1))) * P(0); vec4 s = vec4(0.0); for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) s += src(uv + d * (float(i) / 15.0 - 0.5)); return s / 16.0;

effects.name: Barrido de franjas
effects.glsl: float f = fract(dot(uv - 0.5, vec2(cos(P(4)), sin(P(4)))) * P(1) + uBeat * P(2) * 0.25); vec4 c = src(uv); return vec4(c.rgb * mix(1.0, step(f, P(3)), P(0)), c.a);

effects.name: Túnel
effects.glsl: vec2 p = (uv - 0.5) * vec2(uSize.x / uSize.y, 1.0); float r = length(p) + 0.001; vec2 t = fract(vec2(atan(p.y, p.x) / 6.2832 + P(2) / r * 0.1, 0.25 / r + uBeat * P(1) * 0.25)); return mix(src(uv), src(t), P(0));

effects.name: Coordenadas polares
effects.glsl: vec2 p = uv - 0.5; vec2 t = vec2(atan(p.y, p.x) / 6.2832 + 0.5, length(p) * 1.414); return src(mix(uv, t, P(0)));

effects.name: Esfera
effects.glsl: vec2 p = (uv - 0.5) * vec2(uSize.x / uSize.y, 1.0); float r = length(p) / P(1); if (r >= 1.0) return mix(src(uv), vec4(0.0), P(0)); float z = sqrt(1.0 - r * r); vec2 t = p / (z + 1.0) / P(1) * vec2(uSize.y / uSize.x, 1.0) + 0.5; return mix(src(uv), src(t), P(0));

effects.name: Desplazamiento
effects.glsl: return src(fract(uv + vec2(P(0), P(1)) + vec2(uBeat * P(2) * 0.25, 0.0)));

effects.name: Corte por filas
effects.glsl: float r = floor(uv.y * P(1)); float o = sin(r * 1.7 + uBeat * P(2)) * 0.1 * P(0); return src(fract(uv + vec2(o, 0.0)));

effects.name: Píxel hexagonal
effects.glsl: if (P(0) < 1.0) return src(uv); vec2 p = uv * uSize / P(0); vec2 s = vec2(1.0, 1.732); vec2 a = mod(p, s) - s * 0.5; vec2 b = mod(p - s * 0.5, s) - s * 0.5; vec2 g = dot(a, a) < dot(b, b) ? a : b; return src((p - g) * P(0) / uSize);

effects.name: Flash al ritmo
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); float f = pow(1.0 - fract(uBeat * P(1) / 4.0), 4.0); return vec4(c.rgb + f * P(0), c.a);

effects.name: Corte al ritmo
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); float g = clamp((fract(uBeat * P(1) / 4.0 + P(3)) - P(2)) / max(1.0 - P(2), 0.001), 0.0, 1.0); return vec4(c.rgb * mix(1.0, g, P(0)), c.a);

effects.name: Estelas
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); vec4 m = mem(uv) * P(0); return max(c, m);

effects.name: Eco con zoom
effects.glsl: float a = radians(P(2)); vec2 q = mat2(cos(a), sin(a), -sin(a), cos(a)) * ((uv - 0.5) * uSize) / P(1) / uSize + 0.5; vec4 c = src(uv); return max(c, mem(q) * P(0));

effects.name: Arrastre de píxeles
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); float l = dot(c.rgb, LUMA) * 6.2832; return mix(c, mem(uv + vec2(cos(l), sin(l)) * P(1)), P(0));

effects.name: Congelado al ritmo
effects.glsl: float g = step(fract(uBeat * P(1) / 4.0), P(2)); return mix(src(uv), mem(uv), g * P(0));

effects.name: Retardo de imagen
effects.glsl: return mem(uv);

effects.name: Retardo RGB
effects.glsl: vec4 c = src(uv); return vec4(c.r, mem(uv).g, mem2(uv).b, c.a);

sources.name: Degradado
sources.glsl: float a = radians(P(0)); float t = dot(uv - 0.5, vec2(cos(a), sin(a))) + 0.5 + uTime * P(1); return vec4(vec3(1.0 - abs(fract(t) * 2.0 - 1.0)), 1.0);

sources.name: Damero
sources.glsl: vec2 q = (uv + vec2(uTime * P(1) * 0.1, 0.0)) * vec2(uSize.x / uSize.y, 1.0) * P(0); return vec4(vec3(mod(floor(q.x) + floor(q.y), 2.0)), 1.0);

sources.name: Plasma
sources.glsl: float t = uTime * P(1); vec2 q = uv * P(0); float v = sin(q.x + t) + sin(q.y + t * 1.3) + sin(q.x + q.y + t * 0.7) + sin(length(q) + t); return vec4(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(v + vec3(0.0, 2.1, 4.2)), 1.0);

sources.name: Líneas
sources.glsl: return vec4(vec3(step(fract(uv.x * P(0) + uTime * P(2)), P(1))), 1.0);

sources.name: Círculos
sources.glsl: float r = length((uv - 0.5) * vec2(uSize.x / uSize.y, 1.0)); return vec4(vec3(step(0.5, fract(r * P(0) - uTime * P(1)))), 1.0);

sources.name: Texto
sources.glsl: float a = texture(uTex1, vec2(uv.x, 1.0 - uv.y)).a; return vec4(vec3(P(1), P(2), P(3)) * a, a);
